────────────────────────────────────────
Incumbent CLI 0.7.5
What's new

Windows      : install a signed native Windows x64 CLI with PowerShell; incumbent and cr install per user without WSL or administrator rights
macOS MDM    : IT administrators can deploy a shared signed CLI with the Jamf Pro reference policy using an exact version and architecture-specific hashes
Agents       : fetch Incumbent's trusted all-comments prompt from an installed public or private GitHub pull request using Incumbent authentication
Reviews      : when included reviews are exhausted, eligible developers can confirm usage-based continuation interactively or rerun with --use-credits
Reviews      : reviewed-file paths are indented under their summary for clearer completion output
Updates      : organization-managed installations continue showing available versions but direct engineers to IT instead of incumbent update
Security     : repository-local .env files no longer control CLI service endpoints; remote host overrides require HTTPS and non-Incumbent hosts require explicit opt-in
Reviews      : local review checkpoints avoid redundant diff copies and publish atomically so interrupted writes are not reused
Auth         : OAuth refresh keeps credentials out of request URLs and reports provider failures without exposing token details
Skills       : skill setup avoids unnecessary lock flushes and preserves managed targets when filesystem checks cannot complete
Usage        : incumbent usage aligns labels consistently across every billing state
